load_hf_model_weights: use HfLoader to load Hugging Face model weights from a directory or Hub cache into a FastGen Transformer model
load_model_args_from_hf: use HfLoader to load model arguments from a Hugging Face config.json file and return a ModelArgs dataclass
load_tokenizer_from_hf: use HfLoader to load a Hugging Face tokenizer from a model directory and return a BaseTokenizer instance
map_llama_weights: use LlamaForCausalLM.weight_info to map Hugging Face Llama weight keys to FastGen internal weight names with tensor parallelism info
shuffle_rope_weights: use _rope_shuffle_linear to permute Q/K linear weight tensors from interleaved layout into vanilla Llama layout
